title: Coordination Mechanisms with Partially Specified Probabilities
abstract: arXiv:2605.07469v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A mediator coordinates play in a finite game, but instead of revealing a fully known correlation device it discloses only some statistics of the process that generates players' private messages. Players complete the partially specified process by minimizing a loss over the set of distributions consistent with what is disclosed: maximum Shannon entropy is the leading case, and the analysis covers every strictly convex and symmetric loss that never excludes an event the data do not exclude. We obtain four sets of results. (i) With unrestricted message spaces, the implementable outcomes are exactly the jointly coherent outcomes, namely distributions supported on the support of the set of correlated equilibria. (ii) The characterization is unchanged when players' partial knowledge also concerns the joint distribution of messages and actions, whether or not players know the strategy profile. translated_title: 部分指定概率下的协调机制
translated_abstract: 在一个有限博弈中，中介人负责协调参与者的行动，但它并不揭示一个完全已知的关联装置，而是仅披露生成参与者私有消息之过程的某些统计量。参与者通过在与所披露信息一致的分布集合上最小化某种损失来补全这一部分指定的过程：最大香农熵是代表性的情形，且该分析涵盖了所有严格凸、对称、且从不排除数据未排除事件的损失函数。我们得到了四组结果：(i) 在消息空间不受限制时，可实施的结局恰好是“共同连贯”的结局，即支撑集为相关均衡集合之支撑集的分布；(ii) 当参与者的部分知识还涉及消息与行动的联合分布时，无论参与者是否知道策略组合，上述刻画均保持不变；(iii) 在直接实施下，可实施性……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文研究中介人仅披露部分统计信息、参与者以最大熵等严格凸对称损失补全概率分布的博弈协调机制，证明在消息空间不受限时可实施结局恰好是共同连贯结局（即相关均衡支撑集上的分布），且该刻画对更丰富的部分知识情形依然稳健。
en_tdlr: This paper studies coordination mechanisms in which a mediator discloses only partial statistics of the message-generating process, with players completing the distribution via strictly convex symmetric losses such as maximum Shannon entropy, and shows that implementable outcomes are exactly the jointly coherent outcomes—distributions supported on the support of correlated equilibria—a characterization that remains robust across richer forms of partial knowledge.
